name: wasm4nia
author: Marcus Ramse
description: A rhythm game: hit the notes in time with the music, with 4-Key and Index chart modes and an audio offset setting. X to confirm, Z to go back.

descriptions.en: A rhythm game: hit the notes in time with the music, with 4-Key and Index chart modes and an audio offset setting. X to confirm, Z to go back.
descriptions.it: Un gioco ritmico: premi le note a tempo di musica, con modalità 4-Key e Index e regolazione dell'offset audio. X per confermare, Z per tornare indietro.
